_about: TEST ONLY. Made by tools/lib/make-setup-fixtures.mjs from docs/OFFICE.md, "Barnwright setup access". Never edit it by hand: change the script and run it.
Nothing in it is real: the key pairs, the business, the people and the passes exist only for tests. No Dealer Center or Control Room trusts these keys.
The Control Room's tests copy this file. Times, hashes and signatures in the example answers are examples: match the shapes and the words.

testKey._label: TEST ONLY. The pretend Control Room's key: every good pass below is signed with it. Load the private half with crypto.createPrivateKey({key: privateKeyJwk, format: "jwk"}).

otherKey._label: TEST ONLY. A second key, for a pass signed by somebody else.

pass.signupClaim: optional, last: see beforeSignIn.claim; a pass with a signup that isn't that shape is refused for the reason signup

a support pass sent as a setup pass

a setup pass signed without the prefix
a changed signature (the good check pass with one bit changed)
an actor with a control character
the pass's action isn't the body's
a session pass sent with a door body
the body changed after the pass was made

bad-request.error: The Control Room sent a request this Dealer Center can't read.

too-big.error: That request is too big. Send at most 64 KB.

pass.error: The pass for this request isn't valid. Try again from the Control Room.

pass-used.error: This pass was already used. Each request needs a new pass.

needs-alan.error: Their 3D designer is open, so this change has to be made from your Control Room's Make the change page.

not-connected.error: This Dealer Center isn't connected to Barnwright.

version.error: The price list was saved since you read it. Read it again, then check the change again.

changed.error: The result isn't the one you checked. Check the change again.

cant-undo.error: The owner saved the price list after your change, so undo would take theirs away too. The owner can put back an earlier price list in Price list, History.

account-off.error: Their Dealer Center can't save changes right now: its Barnwright account is off or hasn't checked in for 7 days. Reading still works.

too-many.error: Too many Barnwright requests for this Dealer Center this hour. Try again later.

no-copy.error: Couldn't keep a copy of the current price list first, so nothing was changed. Try again.

error.error: Something went wrong on their Dealer Center. Try again in a minute.

why.not-connected: This Dealer Center isn't connected to Barnwright.
why.no-price-list: The owner hasn't finished First setup yet, so there is no price list to change.
why.terms: The owner hasn't agreed to the Barnwright Terms and Conditions 2.2 yet. They tick the box in First setup, or tap the button at the top of their Dealer Center.
why.stopped: The owner stopped Barnwright's setup access in Settings, Barnwright.
why.live-off: Their 3D designer is open to customers, so you need the owner's switch. Ask the owner to turn on Run checks and change my price list and settings in Settings, Barnwright.
why.signup-terms: They signed up before the Barnwright Terms and Conditions 2.2, so you can't start their price list yet. They agree to the new terms when they first sign in to their Dealer Center.
why.signup-unknown: Their Dealer Center doesn't have the terms they signed up under yet, so you can't start their price list. It gets the newest terms with its next deploy.

door.whyTermsNotOut: Barnwright's new terms (2.2) aren't out yet, so Barnwright can only run checks for now.

effects.about: An extra of the business's own can change how the building is built: a construction effect (options.extras[].construction; model/company.js optionEffects) or How it's built numbers of its own (options.extras[].built, on the buildings its styles list names). Barnwright never adds one, changes one (its effect, its numbers or the buildings it is offered on) or removes an extra that has one; the only building-shape change it can make is a building style's own numbers in How it's built (set_built at the door, and its short form set_roof_pitch). Door samples are checked like edits.samples, on effectBase; visit samples are the visit's PUT price-list with effectBase whose options.extras is replaced by `extras` (and a put back that would do the same is refused alike).

about: Before the owner first signs in (docs/OFFICE.md). The Control Room puts the owner's sign-up agreement and details on every setup pass for that customer, in the claim signup. The Dealer Center takes the agreement for setup access only while no owner has signed in, when it is to terms 2.2 or later that it ships or has a copy of.

The starting price list is the Every standard building template (companies/demo/company.json) set up as First setup sets up a business, from the sign-up's business name, phone and email. Read and check work on it as version 0; the first save with version 0 makes it (version 1) and then saves the edits (version 2).

deploySucceeded.about: Netlify calls a function named for the event, signed by Netlify (it checks the signature before calling it). The body's payload is the deploy as Netlify's API describes it. Only a production deploy, with the function itself running in production, checks in (index.js deploySucceeded -> scheduledCheckIn). Always 204.
